name: Infantry
desc: Slow and tough. Holds long conquests, stops scouts.

name: Scouts
desc: Fast and light. Slip behind the lines, overrun artillery and engineers.

name: Artillery
desc: Hits 3 tiles away. Slow, deadly against infantry and armour.

name: Armour
desc: Heavy tanks: lots of health, conquer cheaply. Fear artillery and engineers.

name: Engineers
desc: Fortify your tiles around them (+defence) and mine enemy armour.

name: Gunboat
desc: Coastal ship: deploys from your coast, hits 3 tiles away and covers landings (-30% cost).

name: Legionaries
desc: Elite infantry of the Imperium: more health and more strength.

name: Republican Guard
desc: Infantry of the Republica: cheap, holds out for a long time.

name: Prototype
desc: Experimental weapon of the Aristocracy: hits 4 tiles away, fragile.

name: Infiltrators
desc: Cabal agents: very fast, conquer cheaply.
